info.title: BagooPH Rider operations
info.description: Implemented backend native operations. See RIDER_OPERATIONS_API.md for locked authority, semantic validation, retry/reconciliation and deployment boundaries. Unknown domain enums require a safe client fallback. Company joining is defined in RIDER_COMPANY_API.md and uses dedicated abilities with no prior placement requirement.

ID.description: Positive ASCII decimal string, no leading zero, at most signed 64-bit maximum. Validate before lookup.

Cents.description: Exact integer PHP centavos; never decode through binary float.

barcode.description: Submitted parcel waybill; shared ASCII trim/uppercase then exact match. No inferred stored barcode.
Submitted parcel waybill; shared ASCII trim/uppercase then exact match. No inferred stored barcode.

proof_image_file.description: Genuine JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 5,242,880 bytes. Original file bytes fingerprint the retry.

cash_received.description: Required for COD; omit or send zero for a verified paid wallet task.

change_given.description: Required for COD; omit or send zero for a verified paid wallet task.

cash_confirmed.description: Accepted confirmation is required for COD. Wallet tasks omit this field or send false/0.

DeliverBody.description: Recipient, waybill and genuine private proof are required for all deliveries. COD requires cash_received, change_given and accepted cash_confirmed. An evidenced paid wallet task requires no cash: omit those fields or use zero amounts and false. The server rechecks the original payment source.

barcode.description: Submitted parcel waybill; shared ASCII trim/uppercase then exact match. No inferred stored barcode.

proof_image_file.description: Genuine JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 5,242,880 bytes. Original file bytes fingerprint the retry.

text.description: Plain text normalized through the shared notes validator; markup and unsafe controls reject.

evidence.description: Non-empty actual JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP/PDF; maximum 5,242,880 bytes. Content must match extension; images retain the shared dimension limits.

CompanyCounterInput.description: Positive whole JSON integer or canonical decimal string through signed 64-bit maximum. The server also rejects raw decimal/exponent numeric encodings.

anyOf.description: Meaningful plain text, NFKC normalized and outer spaces trimmed. Raw and normalized length must fit; hidden controls and markup reject. Blank outer spaces normalize to null.

Error404.description: Hidden, unknown or unavailable retained resource

Error409.description: Stale intent, source or domain conflict
